_notes: Every field that can go stale carries verified_on + source.

confidence: 'verified' = human/first-hand, 'scraped' = agent, 'rule' = a border or policy rule rather than a datapoint (carries no verified_on and never goes stale), 'unknown' = do not display as fact.
Only airports with real sourced data are included. Do not backfill from memory.

border.note: EU and Schengen (air borders since March 2024). Non-Schengen departures cross an external border: EES applies to third-country nationals.
